profile.headline: Software Engineer at Charter Communications
profile.summary: A Software Engineer with 8 years of experience.  Languages and tools include Java, Grails, AngularJS, Node.js, Perl, Selenium, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and JMeter.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develops REST services for Spectrum cable menu guides. Also develops tools for testing REST services. Spearheads the effort to containerize back end applications.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Consultant particularly for test management and test automation.

positions.title: Senior Test Engineer
positions.description: Tests and troubleshoots server side interactive TV applications.  Develops automated testing for REST services using Java, Selenium, and REST-assured.  Develops a REST service UI using Java, AngularJS, and Node.js.  Maintains wiki documentation for end users.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Developer
positions.description: Develops and maintains automated testing for Open Mentoring Software using Java, Grails, and Selenium.  Designs tests to represent the customer experience.  Identifies problems and describes the steps needed to reproduce defects.  Assists with software releases in an agile development environment.  Contributes to UI development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Performs testing engineering services for Missing Link Tools LLC.  Leads the GUI testing effort and designs the framework for these tests.  Participates in enhancement of current functionality and the development of new functionality.  Performs Linux administration and system administration.  Also installs and maintain Windows virtual machines within a Linux host environment.

positions.title: Technology Teacher
positions.description: Teaches elementary and middle school students computer basics such as keyboarding skills and Microsoft Office.  Creates multi-media presentations for the school.  Performs system administrator responsibilities on Macintosh computers, a Macintosh server, WYSE terminals, Windows 7 laptops, Window XP laptops, and Windows Vista laptops.
